offer.text: The raid is upon us! Cut down the attackers before they overrun the homes — six of them, and quickly!

accept.text: Then to arms. Watch the gates.

decline.text: Then we hold the line alone. Pray it's enough.

in_progress.text: Keep at them! The village is counting on you.

complete.text: The village still stands because of you. We won't forget it.

failed.text: We lost too much before help came. The village will remember the cost.
